description.text: The amounts of one academic year tuition fee of different subjects: (per person) Chinese Language Training RMB￥15000 Undergraduate program Liberal arts Science & Engineering Medical Science RMB￥ 16000 RMB￥ 19000 RMB￥ 22000 Master’s program RMB￥ 20000 RMB￥ 25000 RMB￥ 30000 Living costs: Accom- modation Two students share Four students share Facilities On campus Hostel (two bedrooms) RMB￥32 per day/ per student RMB￥16per day/ per student air-conditioner, color TV, card telephone, internet Access, Bathroom, western toilet, beds, desks & chairs, book shelf, wardrobe, kitchen, water heater, washing machine and refrigerator Meals Approximately RMB￥10-20 a day per person Notes: 1. An excellent foreign student can apply for a scholarship of RMB￥2,000-RMB￥10,000 annually. 2. All fees are calculated by RMB and can be paid in Chinese Yuan (RMB) or US dollars. 3. Costs of travel, residence permit, medical insurance, textbooks, and telephone bills are at the expense of the students. 4. The tuition fees and accommodation fees are paid off before the students’ registration.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Yangtze University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Yangtze University Application Form for Foreign Students 2. Personal Statement 3. Senior high school Graduation Certificate 4. Official transcript of senior high school 5. Financial Affidavit of Support 6. A photocopy of passport 7. Physical Examination Records for Foreigners 8. Non-refundable application fee: RMB￥800.

requirements.text: Academic requirements: 1. Applicants have received a senior high school diploma in their countries. 2. Applicants have an educational background equivalent to graduation of a senior high school. Chinese language requirements: 1. For degrees of liberal arts and medicine, applicants must pass HSK Examination Level 4. 2. For degrees of science, engineering, applicants must pass HSK Examination Level 3.
